arguments.description: DreamGraph v14.0.0 release plan, revision 3, supersedes earlier drafts for future implementation: 31 stable pending Markdown slices, C01–C14, NP01–NP13 and twelve project task cases plus sixteen PL01–PL16 lifecycle cases. Revision 3 expands existing Slice 21 and preserves every slice ID. All shipped versions synchronize to 14.0.0 during implementation/release; schema majors remain independent. Per-delta mappings are traceability entries, not extra slices. No implementation approval.

items.change_description: Slice 0: Establish the engine alignment contract. Owner: Core/daemon contract owner. Inventory persisted schema versions, semantic concepts, current writers and all 29 consumer families; resolve unknown historical versions explicitly. Publish generated schema/SDK artifacts and conformance fixtures from the existing core contract; nominate maintainer review responsibilities for trust, persistence and authority. Freeze the twelve task cases and record hashes, mandatory evidence, forbidden assertions and expected outcomes before implementation tuning.
